abort.already_configured: This Hermes companion is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Hermes companion. Check the URL, service, and network access.
error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected. Enter the bearer token configured by the companion.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, a query string, or a fragment.
error.no_capabilities: The companion is reachable but has no Conversation, text-to-speech, or speech-to-text capability available.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs without sharing your token.
error.unsupported_api: The companion uses an unsupported API version. Update Hermes Agent and the Home Assistant integration.

data_description.token: Bearer token configured by the Hermes companion.

reauth_confirm.description: Enter the updated bearer token for this Hermes companion.

data_description.name: Name shown for the integration in Home Assistant.
data_description.token: Bearer token configured by the Hermes companion. Hermes provider credentials stay in Hermes and are not entered here.
data_description.url: Base URL of the provider companion, for example http://hermes-host:8765.
data_description.verify_tls: Keep enabled unless a trusted local companion deliberately uses a self-signed certificate.

user.description: Connect Home Assistant to an authenticated Hermes provider companion. HTTP sends the token without transport encryption; prefer HTTPS when traffic leaves the local host.

error.invalid_tts_provider_voice: The selected TTS voice is not available for the selected provider. Choose a matching provider and voice, or use Hermes defaults.

data_description.default_provider: Provider used unless an automation overrides it. Leave on Hermes default to preserve Hermes routing.
data_description.default_voice: Voice used unless an automation overrides it. Leave on Hermes default to preserve the provider default.
data_description.inference_timeout: Maximum seconds for an inference response (1–300).
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum seconds for health and capability requests (1–300).
data_description.stt_timeout: Maximum seconds for a transcription response (1–300).
data_description.system_prompt: Optional concise instruction applied to Conversation requests.
data_description.verify_tls: Disable only for a deliberately trusted local self-signed endpoint.
